ana: rolled adaptive-prefetch-v2 + kernel-align-auto into a 14-node canary at 07:00. tl;dr: p50 -13%, p95 -19%, p99 -25% on mixed chat/completion; token-cost per-1k down ~16%. :sparkles:

vince: solid. which traces did you run?

perf-bot: run=perf_20240515_0700_ap2_ka_auto, traces=[chat_peak, chat_steady, longform_mixed], throughput:+11%, kvcache_warm_rate:+9% for short prefixes; report: https://perf.internal/reports/perf_20240515_0700_ap2_ka_auto

skye: what's new vs v1 prefetch? any safety/eval regressions?

ana: (typo) ana: v2 adds predictive scoring to pre-warm KV and a jittered backoff to avoid stampedes. kernel-align-auto groups same-quant and same-kernel invocations with <30ms hold to avoid kernel-switch overhead. no safety/e2e regressions on our eval suites. config snippet:
```
prefetch:
  strategy: predictive-v2
  lookback_ms: 150
  score_threshold: 0.55
kernel_align:
  enabled: true
  max_hold_ms: 30
  quant_grouping: auto
```

vince: multiplex/h2 tails?

ana: multiplex p99 improved ~18ms avg; streaming p95 tightened by ~11ms. long sequences (>3500 tokens) fall back to non-aligned kernels.

opsbot: deploy event: canary:eng-runtime/prefetch-v2-kernel-align -> nodes:14 -> status: success -> ts=1729900000

perf-bot: note: warmup window shows a transient allocation spike (~210ms) and slight increase in short-lived GC events; tracked in perf/gc/1729900000. not affecting p99.

skye: rollout plan?

ana: staged rollout: +30% capacity in 6h, +70% in 24h, full flip at 48h if clear. canary oncall pinned for 36h. enterprise-tenant smoke added to gating runs.

prod-checker: sanity checks pass for enterprise tenants in canary run. added automated rollback trigger if p99 regression >5% for 30m.

vince: please draft a 2-line blurb for the monthly eng summary once fully flipped. big win for token-economics. :tada:

ana: will do. tagging @oncall for morning watch. :eyes:
